Doctoral Studies at the Faculties/Institutes
1. Faculty of Theology (Theologische Fakultät)
Forschungsdekanat, Nadelberg 10, 4051 Basel, Tel. +41 61 207 27 94,
e-mail: forschungsdekanat-theol@unibas.ch, homepage https://theologie.unibas.ch/
Doctoral Degrees
- Dr. theol.
- Dr. phil.
General Requirements
Admission to doctoral training with the degree of Dr. theol. requires a Master of Theology in Theology or a
Master of Theology in Semitic Philology from the Faculty of Theology of the University of Basel. Admission
to doctoral training with the degree of Dr. phil. requires one of the following degrees:
a) Master of Arts from the Faculty of Humanities and Socials Science of the University of Basel with
one of the following master's degree subjects as a major or minor: Theology, Jewish Studies, or Reli-
gious Studies;
b) Master of Theology from the Faculty of Theology of the University of Basel;
c) Master of Arts in Interreligious Studies from the Faculty of Theology of the University of Basel;
d) Master of Arts in Religion - Economics - Politics from the Universities of Basel, Lucerne and Zurich.
Other degrees from an institution of higher education recognized by the University of Basel are classified
by the doctoral board as fully, partially or not equivalent.
All degrees must have a grade point average of at least 5 / rounded to one tenth (Swiss grading system 1-
6, 6 = max / 4 = pass). If the degree does not have a grade point average and if this cannot be calculated,
the equivalence of the degree will be reviewed by the doctoral board.
Applicants with a master's degree with a grade point average below 5.0 may be admitted to the doctorate
by way of exception upon application to the doctoral board by the prospective first supervisor and upon
submission of an outstanding scientific qualification thesis (e.g. Master's thesis), if necessary on condition
that they make up missing course credits. Details are regulated in the guidelines.
Regulations
- Doctoral Studies Regulations of the Faculty of Theology, University of Basel, dated 22 May 2023.
Copies of these regulations are available as a download here.
2. Faculty of Law (Juristische Fakultät)
Studiendekanat, Peter Merian-Weg 8, 4002 Basel, Tel. +41 61 207 25 30,
e-mail: studiendekanat-ius@unibas.ch, homepage https://ius.unibas.ch/
Doctorate available in
- Law (Rechtswissenschaft)
General Requirements
Candidates seeking admission to doctoral studies at the Faculty of Law must hold a master’s degree of the
Faculty of Law of the University of Basel with a grade average of at least 5 (in accordance with the Swiss
grading system: 1-6, 6 = maximum / 4 = pass).
Academic qualifications from other universities or higher education institutions recognized by the University
of Basel may be recognized as entirely or partly equivalent by the doctoral board. Candidates may be
granted admission on condition that they make up missing course credits. Candidates seeking admission
must hold an academic degree awarded at least a grade average of 5 (in accordance with the Swiss grading
system: 1-6, 6 = maximum / 4 = pass). Possible requirements shall be determined upon consultation with
the doctoral board and stipulated by the Office of the Rector in conjunction with the granting of admission.
In exceptional cases, candidates holding a degree with a lower grade average may be recommended for
admission to doctoral studies by the doctoral board based on § 9 of the Doctoral Studies Regulations upon
consultation with the proposed main supervisor. They may be admitted on condition that they make up
missing course credits.
Regulations
- For details, please consult the Doctoral Studies Regulations of the Faculty of Law, dated 5 January
2012.
Copies of these regulations are available as a download here.
3. Faculty of Medicine (Medizinische Fakultät)
Dekanat, Klingelbergstr. 61, 4056 Basel, Tel. +41 61 207 19 18, e-mail: diss-medizin@unibas.ch;
homepage https://medizin.unibas.ch
Doctorates leading to the award of a Dr. med. and Dr. med. dent.
Doctorates
- Dr. med.
- Dr. med. dent.
General Requirements
Candidates seeking admission to the doctorate with the degree Dr. med. must hold a master’s degree in
Medicine (Master of Medicine) from a Swiss University or an equivalent degree from a foreign university
and in addition the federal diploma as physician or a medical degree recognized by the Medizinalberufekom-
mission of the Federal Office of Public Health.
Candidates seeking admission to the doctorate with the degree Dr. med. dent. must hold a master’s degree
in Dental Medicine (Master of Dental Medicine) from a Swiss University or an equivalent degree from a
foreign university and in addition the federal diploma as dentist or a dentistry degree recognized by the
Medizinalberufekommission of the Federal Office of Public Health.
Candidates holding a master's degree in Medicine or Dental Medicine of a Swiss university who have not
yet received their federal diploma may be admitted to the respective doctorate for a maximum of one se-
mester on the condition that the diploma is submitted to the Student Administration Office during that se-
mester (deadline: 15 November for the fall semester).
Regulations
- Doctoral Studies Regulations (for the awarding of Dr. med., Dr. med. dent. and Dr. h.c. degrees) of the
Faculty of Medicine, dated 25 April 2022.
Copies of these regulations are available as a download here.
For the PhD in Medical and Health Sciences see 9. "Interfaculty doctorate in Medical and Health Sciences
at the Faculties of Medicine and Science"

General Requirements
Candidates seeking admission to the listed doctoral subjects at the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sci-
ences must hold a master’s degree of the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences of the University of
Basel in a subject/program related to their chosen doctoral subject.
Master’s degrees from other Swiss universities and of the Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology Zürich
and Lausanne are recognized as equivalent where candidates have obtained at least 35 credit points
(ECTS) in a subject studied at postgraduate level that is related to their chosen doctoral subject.
Page 3/7
Other degrees from a different faculty or from a higher education institution recognized by the University of
Basel may be recognized as equivalent by the doctoral board upon consultation with the teaching commit-
tee responsible for a particular doctoral subject.
Candidates holding a master’s degree must in all cases have been awarded a grade average of at least
5.0 / rounded to one tenth (in accordance with the Swiss grading system: 1-6, 6 = maximum / 4 = pass). If
they hold an academic degree without a grade average or if the grade average cannot be calculated, the
doctoral board will review the equivalence to a degree with a grade average of 5.0 / rounded to one tenth
(Swiss grading system).
Regulations
- Doctoral Studies Regulations of the Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences, dated 2 March 2017.
Copies of these regulations are available as a download here.

General Requirements
Candidates seeking admission to the listed subjects must hold a master’s degree from the Faculty of Sci-
ence of the University of Basel qualifying them for their chosen subject of doctoral study. Master’s degrees
from other Swiss Universities or from Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology (‘Eidgenössische Technische
Hochschulen‘) which qualify their holders for the chosen subject of doctoral study are recognized as equiv-
alent.
Other degrees from a higher education institution recognized by the University of Basel or from a different
faculty of the University of Basel may be classified as entirely, partially or not equivalent by the doctoral
board.
Regulations
- Doctoral Studies Regulations of the Faculty of Science, dated 15 September 2015.
Copies of these regulations are available as a download here.
For the PhD in Medical and Health Sciences see 9. "Interfaculty doctorate in Medical and Health Sciences

6. Faculty of Business and Economics (Wirtschaftswissenschaftliche Fakultät)
Graduate School of Business and Economics, Peter Merian-Weg 6, Postfach, 4002 Basel,
Tel. +41 61 207 67 36, e-mail: gsbe-wwz@unibas.ch, homepage https://wwz.unibas.ch/en/gsbe/
Doctorate available in
- Business and Economics (Wirtschaftswissenschaften)
General Requirements
A master's degree from the Faculty of Economics of the University of Basel with a grade point average of
at least 5.0 / rounded to one tenth gives access to the doctorate in economics.
Interfaculty and other degrees of the University of Basel as well as degrees of a university recognized by
the University of Basel can be recognized by the doctoral board as fully or partially equivalent, if neces-
sary with the requirement to make up missing course credits. Any additional requirements will be deter-
mined by the doctoral board. These degrees must also have a grade point average of at least 5.0 /
rounded to one tenth (Swiss grading system 1-6, 6 = highest grade / 4 = sufficient grade). If the degree
does not have a grade point average and if this cannot be calculated, the equivalence of the degree to the
grade point average of at least 5.0 / rounded to one tenth will be reviewed by the doctoral board.
Applicants with university degrees with a grade point average below 5.0 may be admitted to the doctorate
by way of exception upon application to the doctoral board by the prospective first supervisor and upon
submission of an outstanding scientific thesis, if necessary with the condition that they make up missing
course credits. Details concerning the scientific thesis are regulated in the guidelines.
In exceptional cases, applicants with an excellent degree from a non-university higher education institution
recognized by the University of Basel (e.g. a university of applied sciences) may be admitted to the doctor-
ate upon application to the doctoral board by the prospective first supervisor, if necessary with the condi-
tion that they make up missing course credits. Details are regulated in the guidelines.
Regulations
- Doctoral Studies Regulations of the Faculty of Business and Economics, dated 12 June 2023.
Copies of these regulations are available as a download here.

7. Faculty of Psychology (Fakultät für Psychologie)
Studiendekanat, Missionsstrasse 60/62, 4055 Basel, Tel. +41 61 207 06 01,
e-mail: studiendekanat-psychologie@unibas.ch, homepage https://psychologie.unibas.ch/
Doctorate available in
- Psychology
General Requirements
Candidates seeking admission to doctoral studies in psychology must hold a Master of Science in Psy-
chology from the University of Basel. Other degrees from the University of Basel or from a higher educa-
tion institution recognized by the University of Basel may be recognized as entirely or partially equivalent
by the doctoral board. If a degree is considered partly equivalent, admission is granted on condition that
candidates make up a maximum of 24 missing course credits according to § 19, 4 of the Student Regula-
tions. These requirements can either consist of individual courses from the master’s program or the collo-
quium according to § 13 of the Doctoral Studies Regulations of the Faculty of Psychology.
Qualifications from university-level continuing education do not make the holder eligible for admission to
doctoral studies.
Regulations
- Doctoral Studies Regulations of the Faculty of Psychology, dated 18 May 2026.
Copies of these regulations are available as a download here.
8. Institute for Educational Sciences (University of Basel)
Institute for Educational Sciences (University of Basel), FHNW Campus Muttenz, 9. Stock West,
Hofackerstrasse 30, 4132 Muttenz, e-mail: bildungswissenschaften@unibas.ch, Tel. +41 61 207 53 09,
homepage https://bildungswissenschaften.unibas.ch/de/phd/
Doctorates available in
- Educational Sciences
- Subject-Specific Education (Fachdidaktik)
General Requirements
Candidates seeking admission to doctoral training in educational sciences must hold a "Master of Arts
(MA) in Educational Sciences" from the Institute for Educational Sciences of the University of Basel or an-
other master's degree suitable for doctoral studies from the University of Basel or from a higher education
institution recognized by the University of Basel. In the latter two cases, proof of a total of at least 35 credit
points (ECTS, abbreviated to CP) must be provided at master's level in educational sciences, which
should correspond to the master's program educational sciences at the Institute for Educational Sciences
of the University of Basel.
Candidates seeking admission to doctoral training in subject-specific education (Fachdidaktik) must hold a
master's degree suitable for this doctorate from the University of Basel or from a higher education institu-
tion recognized by the University of Basel. Proof must be provided of a total of at least 35 credit points
(CP) in the corresponding subject-specific education, 35 CP in the scientific discipline corresponding to
that subject-specific education, and 25 CP in educational science and educational research methods.
Candidates seeking admission must hold an academic degree awarded a grade average of at least 5.0 /
rounded to one tenth (in accordance with the Swiss grading system: 1-6, 6 = maximum / 4 = pass). If they
hold an academic degree without a grade average or if the grade average cannot be calculated, the doctoral
board will review the equivalence to a degree with a grade average of 5.0 / rounded to one tenth (Swiss
grading system).
Page 6/7
Regulations
- Doctoral Studies Regulations of the Institute for Educational Sciences of the University of Basel,
dated 30 April 2024.
Copies of these regulations are available as a download here.

Information on “Co-tutelle”- Doctorates
‘Co-tutelle‘ doctoral students are registered at two universities, but pay their semester fees only at one
university. The ‘co-tutelle‘ contract defines the university receiving the fees. If it has been agreed on the
University of Basel not being the institute that receives the fees, a copy of the contract signed by all parties
is to be presented to the student administration office at the immatriculation at the latest. Registrations free
of fees without a valid ‘co-tutelle‘ contract are not possible. At present the application fee amounts to CHF
100.-. This fee must be paid to the University of Basel in any case. The doctoral students have to hand in a
copy of the contract to the student administration office of the University of Basel as soon as it has been
signed by all parties.
For questions concerning 'co-tutelle' agreements, you can contact cotutelle@unibas.ch.
